title:
Turkish poetry

content:
Turkish poetry throughout the centuries

Below is a small collection of Turkish poetry from its beginnings in 13th 
century till the early 20th century. You can read a 

short introduction

on the Turkish poetry before you start. If you're interested in the forms
presented below, 
let me know
, 
I'll try to put in more examples of them.

Selections:

 

 
 
     The Book of Dede Korkut (compiled c. 13th century)

     
 

 

           Selected verse

 
 

Yunus Emre (?1238-?1320)

 

 

          Knowledge is to understand /
          To understand who you are."
          

 
 

     Esrefoglu (?-1469)

     
 

 

          O my God do not part me from thee /
          Do not part me from thy sight"
          

 
 

Pir Sultan Abdal

 

 

          "The rough man entered the lover's garden /
          It is woods now, my beautiful one, it is woods,"
          

 
 

     Nedim (?1681-1730)

     
 

 

          SONG
, 

          "Come, let's grant the joy to this heart of ours that 
           founders in distress:  /
           Let's go to the pleasure gardens, come, my sauntering cypress . . ."
     

 
 

Ahmet Hasim

 

 

          PROMISED LAND
 , 

          "Let it play with your hair, this gentle breeze /
           Blowing from the seven seas."
